title: Input-to-State Stabilization of a Coupled ODE-PDE System with Time-Varying Coefficients via Composite Boundary Control
summary: This paper proposes a novel composite boundary feedback control law that ensures input-to-state stability (ISS) for a coupled ODE-parabolic PDE system with time-varying coefficients in both subsystems. In controller design, we circumvent the need to directly solve coupled time-varying parabolic-hyperbolic kernel equations by employing an analytic pre-defined gain function and a time-varying Volterra kernel function to design the control law explicitly.
